title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1+2+Blk, Porcelan – Rezidenca KinoBlock , 161.000 Euro
description_sq:
Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Apartament 2+1
– Rruga e Kokonozeve
– Pallat i 2026, Kati i 2 banim
– Siperfaqja e Bruto 97.53m²
– Siperfaqja e Neto 85.5m²
– Orientimi Veri-Perendim
– Cmimi 161.000 Euro
Shitet apartament i tipologjise 2+1+2 ne Rezidencen Kinoblock, nje nga komplekset me te reja dhe cilesore ne zonen e Porcelanit. Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 97.53 m² dhe karakterizohet nga nje organizim funksional, ndricim natyral dhe hapesira te mire shfrytezuara, duke e bere ideal si per banim familjar ashtu edhe per investim.
Prona organizohet ne nje ambient te perbashket ndenje dhe gatimi, i konceptuar ne stil open space, i cili ofron hapesire te bollshme dhe akses te drejtperdrejte me ballkonin. Kjo hapesire krijon nje ambient te rehatshem dhe te ndricuar gjate gjithe dites, i pershtatshem per jetese sa me komode. Ballkoni sherben si nje element shtese komoditeti, duke ofruar mundesi relaksi dhe ajrosje natyrale.
Zona e nates perbehet nga dy dhoma gjumi te rregullta ne forme dhe te lehta per mobilim. Dhoma matrimoniale ofron hapesire te konsiderueshme dhe disponon gjithashtu dhe nje tualet, ndersa dhoma e dyte eshte e pershtatshme per dhome femijesh, zyre ose dhome garderobe (walk-in closet). Apartamenti disponon dy tualete, te organizuara ne menyre praktike per perdorim familjar, duke rritur ndjeshem komoditetin e perditshem.
Planimetria eshte projektuar per te minimizuar hapesirat e humbura dhe per te krijuar ndarje te qarte mes zones se dites dhe asaj te nates. Korridori shperndares lidh ne menyre efikase te gjitha ambientet, duke garantuar funksionalitet dhe privatese.
Rezidenca Kinoblock ofron standard te larte ndertimi, me izolim termik, dritare dopio xham dhe administrim te mire te ambienteve te perbashketa. Pozicionimi ne zonen e Porcelanit siguron akses te shpejte me qendren e Tiranes, Unazen e Madhe si dhe afersi me sherbime, institucione arsimore dhe rruge kryesore.
Kjo prone perfaqeson nje mundesi shume te mire per ata qe kerkojne nje apartament modern, ne nje zone ne zhvillim dhe me potencial te larte rritjeje ne vlere.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2+Blk, Porcelan - KinoBlock Residence, 161.000 Euro
description_en: Property Features: - Apartment 2+1 - Rruga e Kokonozeve - Building 2026, 2nd residential floor - Gross Area 97.53m² - Net Area 85.5m² - Orientation North-West - Price 161,000 Euro 2+1+2 apartment for sale in Kinoblock Residence, one of the newest and quality complexes in the area of Porcelain. The apartment has a total area of ​​97.53 m² and is characterized by a functional organization, natural lighting and well-utilized spaces, making it ideal for both family living and investment. The property is organized in a common living and cooking environment, designed in an open space style, which offers ample space and direct access to the balcony. This space creates a comfortable and bright environment throughout the day, suitable for living as comfortably as possible. The balcony serves as an additional element of comfort, offering opportunities for relaxation and natural ventilation. The night area consists of two bedrooms, regular in shape and easy to furnish. The matrimonial room offers considerable space and also has a toilet, while the second room is suitable for a children's room, an office or a walk-in closet. The apartment has two toilets, organized in a practical way for family use, significantly increasing daily comfort. The layout is designed to minimize wasted spaces and to create a clear separation between the day and night areas. The distribution corridor efficiently connects all rooms, guaranteeing functionality and privacy. The Kinoblock residence offers a high standard of construction, with thermal insulation, double-glazed windows and good management of common areas. Positioning in the area of ​​Porcelan ensures quick access to the center of Tirana, the Great Ring Road, as well as proximity to services, educational institutions and main roads. This property represents a very good opportunity for those looking for a modern apartment, in a developing area with high growth potential. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
